content:
tomas: quick note - onboarded model-w (int8) into longctx harness and observed subtle "edge-fold" artifacts past ~36k tokens. not the classic wrap/repeat; tokens are slightly corrupted then recover after a few tokens. filing here for visibility.

neha: can you paste the minimal repro and any quick diffs vs fp16? sounds like interpolation or spline edge effect.

tomas: repro command: `./onboard_long --model model-w:int8 --prompt tests/long_40k.json --rotary-scale 1.15 --kv_window 65536 --quant int8 --seed 9`
log snippet:
```
# around pos 36012..36020
... "authentication" -> "authentcation" then back to "authentication"
phase_trace: pos=36012 delta=2.3e-4, pos=36013 delta=-4.7e-4
rot_lookup: table_idx=2250 frac=0.11 (using lowmem spline interp)
# fp16 baseline: no corruption, phase_delta ~ 1e-8
```

liang: lowmem spline interp? we added a cubic-spline lookup for rotary to reduce table size in quant builds. This could produce small Gibbs-like edge artifacts near table segments.

sara: yeah, earlier PR swapped linear->spline and quant pack changed lane boundaries. combination could create small non-smooth derivatives that affect phase. try `--rotary-lookup linear` or `--rotary-table-highres` as quick tests.

tomas: tried both: `--rotary-lookup linear` reduced frequency of corruptions but didn't eliminate, `--rotary-table-highres` removed them on the sample run.

neha: interesting. so spline is the likely culprit, but linear still problematic due to quant accumulation. we should: 1) add a regression test comparing tokens across positions up to kv_window for fp16 vs quant with different lookup modes; 2) gate spline lookup behind a model-onboard flag and document memory/quality tradeoffs.

liang: also add a runtime check that computes analytic sin/cos for a handful of high positions and diffs the lookup output; if diff>eps, log and (optionally) fallback to highres/analytic for that request. cheap and targeted.

ops-bot: created issue INF-8422 (https://redwood.internal/INF-8422) and set canary slot 5 to 5% traffic. Assigned: tomas.

tomas: noted. i'll add the unit sweep to onboarding/quality and put a quick opt-in flag for spline lookup. will update INF-8422 with artifacts: /artifacts/model-w/1795002222/. thanks.

sara: also record the exact rotary_scale used during training in model metadata so we can catch scale mismatches in onboarding automatically.

neha: agreed. adding to checklist: "verify rotary lookup fidelity (linear/spline/highres) + analytic spot-checks for positions > training_window".

tomas: will follow up with a small perf/ram comparison for spline vs highres to decide default.
